statement: Section 5/Figure 7 attributes GLU's primary benefit to faster optimization rather than a materially smaller generalization gap in the considered real-model experiments.

machine_contract.verification: Both premises must hold: (a) GLU accelerates optimization and (b) its matched-loss generalization-gap difference is practically equivalent to non-GLU.
machine_contract.optimization_scoped_test: ReGLU has lower 0-15 epoch training-loss AUC in at least 2 of 3 paired seeds.
machine_contract.gap_equivalence: A seed-level two-one-sided t test rejects effects outside +/-0.10 cross-entropy at alpha=0.05; epochs are not treated as independent replicates.
machine_contract.falsification: A counterexample must satisfy every source setting, including the official default Mixer capacity and 100-epoch horizon, then contradict either premise.
source_assumptions: official default dim=256/depth=4 for the source script
SGD lr=0.005, momentum=0.9, no weight decay
matched training loss for gap comparison

final_verdict_rule: If the full source setting is not completed and no assumption-complete counterexample exists, the combined claim is BLOCKED even when a scoped component is supported.
